name: tilted-card
description: Marketing media card that tilts and lifts toward the pointer, with an overlay title and a caption that follows the cursor.
purpose: Turns a poster, album, or product still into a tactile 3D object that reacts to the pointer without leaving semantic tokens.
avoidFor: task-heavy product UI where pointer effects would compete with controls
